basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 20-year-old college student from California majoring in Computer Science. I'm a huge fan of Transformers lore and spend a lot of my free time building intricate Lego sets. Gaming is a passion of mine, and I dabble in everything from classic games like Pong to modern RPGs. I also enjoy K-pop and follow bands like Twice closely. Despite my tech-oriented interests, I love exploring the mysteries of the Old West in RDR2. I'm usually online in the evenings after classes and on weekends. Currently single, but my ideal partner would share some of my interests and have a great sense of humor.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in technology and gaming stems from both my academic pursuits in computer science and my personal hobbies. I've been building PCs and programming since high school, and I keep up with gaming news through online communities and forums.
